method: PlayerController simulated keys; teleports and injected incoming/phase/lethal hits are deterministic test fixtures. AI, hit resolver, stamina, map reload, move component and Enhanced Input are live.

checks.check: first normal mouse input rotated camera during startup; oversized recenter warp was discarded
W walks; Tab toggles torso lock on and off
early second click persisted; first swing dealt 20 and spent 15 without shortening recovery
buffered two cuts dealt 50 and consumed 35; dodge took priority and consumed 22 only after the active window closed
Space dodge travelled 280cm; injected incoming hits inside and outside invulnerability matched
right mouse parried simulated sword; queued E began at parry recovery and struck dummy for 40
fresh parry after oath impact interrupted attack recovery immediately
early defense during parry cooldown did not execute later
held and released Shift switched 650/450 speed while movement stayed held
